title: What If Your Heart Had No Pulse? A Man Lived Like That

scenes.text: What if you had no heartbeat and no pulse? Doctors have tried it, and it worked.
Texas Heart Institute surgeons built an artificial heart from two spinning pumps.
Instead of beating, the rotors push blood in one smooth, steady stream.
It was tested on calves first. One calf had no pulse yet stayed active and healthy.
Then, in 2011, it went into a man dying of an organ disease. He lived more than a month with no pulse.
The pumps worked flawlessly. A doctor checking his wrist would have found nothing, only a faint hum.

description:
What if your heart had no pulse?
Surgeons built a continuous-flow heart, and one patient lived over a month without a heartbeat.
